text:
Lina P: Quick sync — OrionFW and Redwood are kicking off a joint perf/W run tomorrow. Need to lock the test matrix, telemetry, and a lightweight announcement cadence. Who owns the public-facing numbers?
OrionFW (Partner): We can provide HW inventory and power caps. Target racks: 2x A100-equivalent blades, stock BIOS. We prefer a 48h soak + three sweep points (200W, 275W, 350W).
Sam R: Sounds good. For reproducibility we should pin: model hash, tokenizer, seq len distribution, and batch policy. I can drop a config.
Keiko N: Also add kernel flags and driver versions. We'll capture perf counters for KV cache hit rates. Minimum acceptance: perf/W uplift >= 10% over baseline or clear regression detected.
Ryan Q: Test harness is ready. We'll run the standard load profile (conns=64, qps per client=100) and the eval prompts from /bench/prompts/edge-suite. Make sure the dataset is identical on both sides.
Sam R: config snippet below (will commit to repo):
```
bench run --model redwood-3b --commit 9f4a2b --seq-dist "512:0.2,1024:0.5,2048:0.3" --duration 2h \\
  --power-targets 200,275,350 --clients 64 --batching continuous --log-level info
```
OrionFW (Partner): We'll apply BIOS perf profile "latency-optimized" and share IPMI power logs + per-socket thermals. Expect 1h setup tomorrow morning.
Sam R: Kernel flags we want tested: `nomce=off transparent_hugepage=never amd_iommu=on` (or intel equivalent). Also collect `perf stat -e instructions,cycles,cache-references,cache-misses`.
Keiko N: For public numbers: agree to a draft embargoed slide deck. We should prepare both "raw numbers" and a normalized perf/W chart. If results look good, marketing wants a co-announcement within 1 week.
Tom G: Marketing ask: please include artifact list we can review (plots, scripts, hardware bill-of-materials). I'll coordinate the co-announcement timeline with Orion comms.
OrionFW (Partner): Confirmed on comms. We'll need to sign a short MFA with legal (data = aggregated telemetry only). Can we get an embargoed deck by EOD Friday?
Ryan Q: Running the first smoke now. CI job: `bench-smoke/orion-edge/3632129876`
build-bot: CI started for bench-smoke/orion-edge/3632129876 — logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/bench-smoke/3632129876 
Sam R: Early smoke looks sane — single-node throughput ~ 1.2k tok/s at 200W; perf/W ~ 6.0 tok/s/W. Still need the multi-node sweep.
OrionFW (Partner): Nice — we'll validate power curves and compare to our internal baseline.
Lina P: Great momentum. Next steps: (1) Sam & Orion to finalize kernel/BIOS tweaks this morning, (2) Ryan to run full 48h soak starting 09:00 PT tomorrow, (3) Keiko/Tom draft embargoed deck by Friday EOD. I'll ping legal about the short NDA for telemetry. @everyone please drop any missing checklist items here. :rocket:
